summary: Automatic updates can no longer change your activation policies without an operator agreeing first.

fixes.title: Automatic updates protect your policies
fixes.text: An overnight update that would change the activation policy baseline now stops and reports what would change. Normal updates are unaffected.

fixes.title: Admin account domain list works
fixes.text: On tenants with many verified domains, the picker showed one long option. It now lists each domain separately.

fixes.title: Records tables show all rows
fixes.text: Long tables were cut off at the window height with no way to scroll. All rows are visible again.

fixes.title: Admin accounts uses the full screen
fixes.text: The Admin accounts table now fills wide displays instead of sitting in a narrow column.
